canonical.question: What home-stay cancellation-policy section and refund-deadline time basis does the Airbnb home-reservation cancellation guidance give?
canonical.expected_secondary: Cancellation deadlines for receiving refunds are measured from the check-in time for the listing in its local time zone, or 3:00 PM if no check-in time is specified.
canonical.tampered_primary: All home stays are fully refundable at any time after check-in.
